description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to Land Parcels Mullaikkulam, Vavuniya D/S Division, Vavuniya District - Cad. Map No. 950029 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership or possession of land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership in specific districts and villages. The content focuses on land administration and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
